usage_requirements: CLS-token pooling (last hidden state of [CLS]), NOT mean pooling — mean pooling causes a significant performance drop
L2-normalize embeddings and compare with cosine similarity / inner product

For short query -> long passage retrieval, prepend the query prefix 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: ' to queries only (never to passages); in v1.5 the prefix is optional with only slight retrieval degradation, and no prefix is needed for symmetric similarity tasks
No trust_remote_code required (standard BERT architecture, works with sentence-transformers and vanilla transformers)
Max input 512 tokens; longer inputs are truncated
known_issues: Similarity scores are compressed into roughly [0.6, 1.0] because of contrastive training with temperature 0.01 — a score above 0.5 does not imply similarity; only relative ranking is meaningful, and any absolute threshold must be calibrated on your own data (typically 0.8-0.9)
Using mean pooling instead of CLS pooling silently degrades quality (documented by FlagEmbedding maintainers)
v1.5 was released specifically to alleviate the v1.0 similarity-distribution issue and improve no-instruction retrieval, but the compressed score range still applies
unknowns: benchmark_scores independent verification (MTEB leaderboard entries for this model are ingested from the model card's own model-index metadata, so no non-self-reported source was found; both scores are flagged self_reported)
